description: This Java class 'BaseMessageFilter' provides methods to validate and annotate AMQP messages with required properties such as device ID, tenant ID, resource path, and correlation ID. It is used for ensuring message integrity and consistency within the Eclipse Hono project.

classes.name: BaseMessageFilter
classes.description: A utility class for filtering and validating AMQP messages based on mandatory properties.

methods.name: verifyStandardProperties
methods.description: Checks if a message contains valid device ID and annotates it with resource info if valid.

methods.name: hasValidDeviceId
methods.description: Validates that the message contains a correct device ID matching the resource identifier.

methods.name: hasCorrelationId
methods.description: Checks if the message contains either a message ID or a correlation ID for message correlation.
